title: Plan stats
tabs.label: Plan views
empty: No sessions were due in this period
period.label: Period
period.bad: Check the dates: the start must be before the end
kpi.rate_tip:
Of the sessions that were due, how many you did (done, partly and a different session all count as done); below: how many were planned in the period and the completion rate.
Due = dated before today, or today and already done.
"Not synced" = a past day the synced data doesn't cover yet; left out for now.
Deleted past sessions don't count.
kpi.ok_tip: Sessions done as planned (✓); below: their share of the due sessions (on target).
kpi.tss_tip:
Due sessions: actual TSS ÷ planned TSS (intervals.icu's Compliance).
A skipped session counts 0. The bar stops at 100 %.
kpi.hours_tip: Due sessions: actual moving time vs planned time (strength excluded, like the weekly volume).
kpi.streak_tip:
Consecutive recent weeks with at least one session done.
A rest or paused week (nothing planned all week) doesn't break it; this week counts once a session is done and doesn't break it before.
phase.title: Current phase
phase.tip:
The current phase of the season plan: days gone, how much of the phase's sessions are done, how many are left.
Phase TSS = the planned TSS of all the phase's sessions (upcoming included); actual = what the due ones reached.
weeks.title: Planned vs actual per week
weeks.aria: Bars per week: planned (dashed outline) and actual (filled)
weeks.tip:
Planned vs actual volume per week.
How to read: dashed outline = planned (the stored plan: done, skipped and upcoming sessions); filled = actually done (every activity, unplanned ones included).
Look for: filled bars that never reach the outline = the plan is too much; far above it = too little planned or a lot of extra training.
Method: the same numbers as the weekly summary on the calendar.
trend.title: Sessions done per week
trend.aria: Bar chart of the sessions done per week
trend.tip:
How many sessions you did each week (done, partly and a different session all count).
It only adds up — no pass line; a skipped session is left to the auto-adjust, nothing to make up.
kinds.title: By session type
kinds.tip:
Sessions done per type.
How to read: green = done, orange = partly, hatched = a different session, grey = skipped; on the right: completion and count.
Method: done = time and TSS within ±20% of the plan (TrainingPeaks' compliance colours).
Quality sessions are split into aerobic intervals, VO2max intervals and speed (a session without a type is read from its steps); hover the numbers on the right for planned → actual TSS.
list.title: Sessions
list.tip:
The percentage is the compliance: actual TSS ÷ planned TSS, time when there is no TSS.
Click to open the session on the calendar (planned vs actual, re-pair).
ratio.title: Load ratio ATL ÷ CTL
ratio.tip:
Load ratio ATL ÷ CTL: 7-day fatigue divided by 42-day fitness.
How to read: the line takes the colour of its band: grey < 0.8 low, green 0.8–1.3 normal, yellow 1.3–1.5 high, red > 1.5 spike; the latest value is labelled on the right.
Look for: 1 = as usual; grey in a recovery week or taper is normal, so is a spike after a multi-day Baiyue trip.
Method: bands from Runalyze (citing Gabbett 2016); a direction, not an injury prediction.
ratio.aria: Daily ATL ÷ CTL line over four shaded bands: low, normal, high, spike
ratio.empty: No data for this range yet

How to read: dashed outline = planned (the stored plan: done, skipped and upcoming sessions); filled = actually done (every activity, unplanned ones included).
Look for: filled bars that never reach the outline = the plan is too much; far above it = too little planned or a lot of extra training.
Method: the range follows the period or phase picked above.
weeks.tip_month:
Planned vs actual volume per month.
How to read: dashed outline = planned (the stored plan: done, skipped and upcoming sessions); filled = actually done (every activity, unplanned ones included).
Look for: filled bars that never reach the outline = the plan is too much; far above it = too little planned or a lot of extra training.
Method: the range follows the period or phase picked above; the first and last months count only the days in range.

history.title: Weekly record
history.tip:
The plan is saved as it stood when each week began (later edits and re-planning never change it), and once the week is over, how much of it was done. After half a year or more, together with a baseline test every 6–8 weeks and race results, these records show whether training by the plan made you better.
A week is final {n} days after it ends; until then a late sync or a manual pairing still updates it.
Mark races on the Activities page with “Race”.
history.late_tip: The app wasn't opened when this week began, so this is the plan as it stood at the end of the week, not as first planned
history.pending: The result is added the next time the app is opened
history.empty: Nothing saved yet: once the schedule page is opened, each week is saved automatically

now.tip:
Numbers that only add up: what you did this week and how much it comes to.
What was planned, the completion rate and every session are in the coach view below.
